name: Reverse Cable Curl
cues: Set a straight bar on a low pulley and grip it palms down
Stand close enough that the cable is taut at the bottom
Keep your wrists straight and your elbows at your sides
Curl to your chest and lower to straight arms

qa.note: Wave 3a 2026-10-08: rated ok by the lane review, auto-approved. ok: Pronation 44 to 79 deg, in line with approved 714 (31 to 56). Elbow 15 to 140, wrist flex 3 to 10 (fairly straight). Elbows 5.5 cm ahead of the shoulders at the top. Bar clears the thighs by 16 mm. The cable stays taut at the bottom.
